traits.name: Charge.
traits.text: If the centaur moves at least 30 ft. straight toward a target and then hits with a hooves attack in the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and must succeed on a DC 13 STR save or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack.
actions.text: The centaur makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its longbow.

actions.name: Hooves.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Longbow.
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
